text:
Markets got me off the beach. :) 

Nice move by #Bitcoin and crypto. Similar moves in metals.  Obviously a lot of short covering off a 2 month consolidation, but bullish nonetheless.  

Little more work to do before a bear market bottom can be confirmed, and a new 4Yr cycle start. Closing out the month strong above (10 month MA) $74k first step, then a weekly close above the $82.8k highs swings the high TF trends back to bullish.  

Either way, very close now.  Excited to get back to the desk in Sept.
